design.anchor_rule: informed: m_i = anchor x max(0, 1 - n_i / 6), n_i the player's edges in the snapshot
design.snapshots: every distinct tournament date of the tour, from earlier dates' edges
design.within_event: one-step local Newton update per earlier round of the same event
design.mesr_anchor_rule: m_i = anchor for a player with at most one odds edge in the snapshot, 0 otherwise
design.mesr_edges: matches with a coherent closing-odds probability (stage1_odds.parquet p_avg_a), completed or retired, from 2010
design.games_weight: the winner's share of the games over Stage 4's 2010-2018 mean (1 where the score has no games), times the retirement weight
